corpus_status: synthetic authoring; not production traces or promotion evidence
label_basis: The five positive labels are the exact operations described by the referenced contract purposes and I/O/effect boundaries. none means no single listed contract fully satisfies the request.

sources.evidence: Contract purpose, typed input/output, effects, permissions, and failures.
text.normalize r1 purpose, one text input and normalized text output.
report.fold r1 purpose, inspection collection input, canonical digest output.
Inference outputs are observations; capability admission, execution authority, and policy remain separate.
Capability contract and observation vocabulary used in this corpus.

known_ambiguities: Synthetic unsupported tasks can sometimes be composed from multiple capabilities, but the prompt requires one contract to satisfy the request by itself.

Some natural-language requests omit implementation-specific preconditions such as supplied inspection data or an existing destination; labels assume stated preconditions exactly and do not infer access or authority.
report.publish means a capability contract match only; it does not establish the caller has a grant or approval.
held_out_scope: These are groups held out from this v2 corpus training split. Their semantic families are not all novel relative to the older collection-match corpus or its held-out groups.
